Name: MAP_NAME_TEX_PARAM_ST
Description: Place-name areas of the overworld (m60; m61 uses MapNameTexParam_m61). The game reads the map info texture of the 1024 m tile the player is on (256 × 256 pixels, 4 m per pixel, north up): the green channel of the pixel under the player is the row ID (0–255). No row for that value: no place name.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Red
Fields.Description: Red of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Green
Fields.Description: Green of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Blue
Fields.Description: Blue of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Place Name ID
Fields.Description: PlaceName text of this area, shown by the place-name banner; the text is the absolute value and the sign picks when the banner appears. Negative: shown each time the player enters from an area with a different name. Positive: shown only if no place-name banner has been shown since the last reset, so walking in from a named neighbouring area shows nothing (retail uses both signs for most regions). 0: no name. Also the default save location name (MapPieceTexParam).
